title: Weather stations: the bundled stations and the annual rain
intro: Weather stations lists the stations that come with Daisy. Choosing one draws its annual rain; the station can be used as the SWAFL weather or added to the list of logs for the plots.

marks.d: The bundled stations, each with its years and number of days.
Latitude of the station, used to work out reference evapotranspiration when it is not recorded.
Sends the station to the main workbench as its weather.
Puts the station among the logs that the plot tabs can draw.
Sum of the daily rain of each year of the record.
